_meta.purpose: Pattern analysis of $2000+ couture/bridal fashion brands → keyword+channel+geo+subpage+adjacency pattern for Maison
_meta.source: SimilarWeb MCP, workflow wf_d7417ce1-f84 (6 brands + cached refs)
brands: sabyasachi.com (~230K/mo, Indian heritage bridal — closest analog)

channel_pattern.headline: $2000+ couture = ORGANIC + DIRECT dominant (82-95%), near-ZERO paid for heritage houses. More couture/heritage → less paid; more accessible/RTW → more paid.
channel_pattern.contrast: Sau Lee ($475-895) paid search 25.3%; Guo Pei (couture-only) OrganicSocial 49.7% > search. Lower price = more paid.

keyword_pattern.branded_share: 85-98% BRANDED — discovered BY NAME, not category. (Reem Acra ~97%, Sabyasachi ~88%, Zuhair ~85%, Elie Saab ~90%, Monique ~85%; Galia Lahav outlier ~50% via celebrity-wedding SEO)
nonbranded_that_converts: CELEBRITY/RED-CARPET (strongest): 'zendaya wedding dress', 'alia bhatt met gala saree', 'met gala 2025'
OCCASION/BRIDAL: 'white wedding lehenga', 'haute couture wedding guest dresses'
keyword_pattern.insight: Category head terms ('luxury dress') each cap <5% → dead end. Win by celebrity-name halo + occasion+brand long-tail. Accessory + 'cheaper line' searches reveal entry-tier demand these houses under-serve.

geo_pattern.headline: US #1 or top-2 for almost all; CA/UK/AU recur as top-6 (Anglophone diaspora); India in top-6 of ALL.
geo_pattern.diaspora_archetype: Sabyasachi = India 59% + Pakistan 9 / US 8 / AU 4 / CA 4 / UAE 2.9 → heritage house = home-market + diaspora. Maison analog (HYPOTHESIS, no VN data): Vietnam + Việt diaspora US/AU/CA.
geo_pattern.gulf: modest — Elie Saab Saudi 6.2%; strongest for Middle-East-heritage houses.

engines: NAMED SEASONAL COLLECTION landing (Zuhair /couture-spring-summer-2026 = 16.1%, biggest page in set)
APPOINTMENT/consultation page as couture conversion endpoint (Reem Acra /appointments = #2 page 8.1%)
subpage_pattern.takeaway: Homepage is NOT the entry. Winning structure = bridal hub + named collection pages + deep-link PDPs + appointment page + accessories entry-tier.

adjacency_trace_ANSWER_to_highend_journe.verdict: WEAK-TO-ABSENT for watches / jewelry-houses / real-estate / 5-star-hotels / luxury-travel. NO co-visitation to those verticals surfaced for ANY brand.

what_IS_seen.discovery_social: Instagram (Sabyasachi affinity 76 = strongest co-visit), Pinterest (Galia 69), YouTube, TikTok
what_IS_seen.gen_ai_tools: ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini heavy (Sabyasachi, Elie Saab, Monique) → AI-search optimization is an emerging channel

adjacency_trace_ANSWER_to_highend_journe.what_is_NOT_seen: watches/jewelry brand sites, real estate portals, hotel/airline/travel — NONE.
adjacency_trace_ANSWER_to_highend_journe.conclusion: CANNOT credibly target 'couture buyers also browse watches/hotels/RE' on this evidence. Defensible adjacency audiences = IG/Pinterest visual discovery + luxury dept-store shoppers (Saks/Nordstrom) + luxury-resale (TheRealReal) + elevated contemporary e-com (Revolve/Reformation). NOTE: absence of data ≠ proof of no behavior (hard-luxury sites may be too low-frequency to surface).
adjacency_trace_ANSWER_to_highend_journe.vn_brands_gated_confirmed_2026-07-03: audience-interests endpoint tested on all 7 VN brands (congtri, phanhuy, huy-vo, thuydesignhouse, phuongmy, xeoxo, hacuc) → ALL returned 404 (below threshold). So adjacency is derived ONLY from large international houses and inferred for Maison — NOT measured on any Vietnamese brand's actual audience.

CRITICAL_caveat_scale_mismatch: These are 100K+/mo houses with decades of brand equity. Their ORGANIC+BRANDED dominance & 0% paid is the END STATE of houses that ALREADY won brand recall. Maison is emerging → must CREATE demand → likely needs MORE paid/social seeding early. Do NOT read '0% paid search' as 'avoid paid'; read it as the target state after brand recall is built.
google_ads_mcp_assessment: Official Google repo but minimal + READ-ONLY: 3 tools (search account / metadata / list-customers). NO keyword planner, NO campaign creation, NO competitor/audience/market data — only the connected account's own data. Needs Ads account + developer token + OAuth. Cannot answer 'what luxury shoppers search' nor build audiences. Keyword Planner + In-market/Custom audiences live in the FULL Google Ads API/UI, not this MCP.
